kjv: Thou [art] a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec
note: TR completes the quotation with "kata ten taxin Melchisedek"; absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, B, C.

kjv: a surety of a better testament
mine: the guarantor of a better covenant
note: diatheke in Hebrews 7–10 is the covenant of Jer 31 (8:8–10, where the KJV has "covenant"); the KJV alternates "testament" and "covenant" for the same word.
